items.title: Is Intel (INTC) Stock Above Fair Value Or Still Below It?
items.summary: Intel stock has surged over the past year, yet valuation checks send a mixed signal, with a fairly valued intrinsic estimate and a low overall value score sitting alongside a market-multiple read that points to upside. After such a sharp move, the question for investors is whether Intel still offers enough value support at current levels. items.title: Investors Don’t Seem to Believe Nvidia’s Earnings Story
items.summary: Nvidia—having beaten analysts' already high expectations for the 15th quarter in a row—may be in league of its own in tech. But Wall Street sure isn't acting like it. The forward price to earnings ratio for shares of the world's most valuable company is dragging behind chip-makers and other large tech players, perhaps because of concerns about financing risks, long-term revenue generation, or expectations that are just too high.
